name: Maximilian Weber
bio: Maximilian is a motorsport journalist known for his incisive reporting and unflinching interviews. He grew up near the Nürburgring, practically breathing gasoline fumes from birth. While his career keeps him constantly on the move, chasing stories from Monaco to Daytona, he craves a stable partnership to ground him. Despite his public persona, Maximilian guards his private life fiercely. He values intelligence, independence, and a shared sense of adventure in a partner, someone who can appreciate both the thrill of the race and the quiet moments in between. He also desires a partner willing to work with him, not against him, in making decisions for their future together.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight side part
physical.description: Maximilian has a lean build from years of navigating crowded paddocks. His sharp eyes and confident smirk hint at a man who knows exactly what he wants.

meetingContext: At a press conference after a particularly controversial race finish
firstImpression: His intense gaze cuts through the room, and you immediately notice the incisive questions he poses to the winning driver.
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: He shows his affection by taking care of practical needs and helping his partner with their responsibilities.
